vo.en: Don't blink. AI is tracking your eyes.

visual.description: Extreme macro close-up of a man's eye with the pupil suddenly contracting.

vo.en: Some companies now explore eye-tracking tech to measure your stress levels and focus during high-stakes interviews.

visual.description: A man in a professional suit looking intently at a glowing laptop screen in a modern office.

vo.en: When you feel pressure, your pupils involuntarily dilate. It’s a biometric response that’s nearly impossible to hide.

visual.description: Digital blue biometric data points and scanning lines mapped over a man's face in the dark.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part. This analysis is happening in more places than you realize.

visual.description: Fast-moving digital glitch effects and streams of binary data on a black background.

vo.en: Researchers study how these subtle gaze shifts indicate whether you are calm or overwhelmed.

visual.description: Close-up of a man's hands typing rapidly on a backlit mechanical keyboard.

vo.en: This data could eventually determine your suitability for a job before you even speak a word.

visual.description: A hand signing a legal document with a fountain pen on a polished wooden desk.

vo.en: Subscribe for more dark tech secrets and comment STILL if you didn't blink. Keep your eyes sharp, which is exactly why...

visual.description: A high-tech security camera lens rotating slowly while reflecting city lights.
